1. Data Protection
TRUE CARE is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Data Protection Act of Kenya. We collect information only necessary for service provision.

2. Information Collection
We collect your name, phone number, location, and health snapshots to connect you with the best care professional.

3. Payment Security
All M-Pesa transactions are processed securely via Safaricom Daraja API. We do not store your M-Pesa PIN.

4. Data Sharing
Your information is shared only with assigned caregivers or patients for the duration of a shift.

5. Compliance
We adhere to Kenyan healthcare and digital privacy regulations.
